```{r paths}
# cross_sectional = TRUE: the SHCS trajectories with the cross-sectional calls, read from and written to their own folders
lod_sub <- if (params$cross_sectional) "LoD/cross_sectional" else "LoD"
resources_lod <- file.path("resources", lod_sub)
results_lod   <- file.path("results", lod_sub)
figures_lod   <- file.path("figures", lod_sub)
for (d in c(resources_lod, results_lod, figures_lod)) dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
shcs_calls_file <- if (params$cross_sectional) file.path(resources_lod, "chip_calls_long_filtered.txt") else "resources/chip_calls_long_filtered.txt"
```

`r if (params$cross_sectional) "**Sensitivity analysis: this run uses the SHCS trajectories that include the cross-sectional calls.** The paths named in the text are those of the main analysis; this run reads and writes the folders cross_sectional under them."`


```{r}
source("R/Set_colors.R")
source("R/spline_functions.R")
```

The SHCS trajectories (`resources/chip_calls_long_filtered.txt`) and the SardiNIA trajectories
(`resources/LoD/sardinia_chip_calls_long_filtered.txt`) get
the main spline (`spec_main` = `r spec_main_name`), extrapolated back, and four ages on the rise of the extrapolated curve
to CHIP (up to the first age at which it reaches 2%):

| Age | Threshold |
|---|---|
| `Age_zero` | last age at which the curve is <= `r zero_vaf * 100`% |
| `Age_LoD2` | last upward crossing of half the mean LoD of the trajectory |
| `Age_LoD` | last upward crossing of the mean LoD of the trajectory |
| `Age_0.02` | age at which the curve reaches 2% |

An age is `NA` (left-censored) when the curve is above its threshold during the whole rise.

`Age_LoD2` replaces 0% as the point at which a clone is taken to appear: below half the LoD of the trajectory nothing is known about
its size. `Age_zero` is kept for comparison. Because the LoD depends on depth, the VAF at which
`Age_LoD2` and `Age_LoD` are read differs between trajectories, and is higher in SardiNIA (section 1).

**Curves extrapolated to LoD / 2.** A
curve is extended back from its first measurement to the last age at which the spline is below half the LoD of the trajectory, in place of
`r zero_vaf * 100`%, and floored at this value as in
`01_spline_fits.Rmd`. A curve that is already below this value at the first measurement is not extended.

The notebook writes, in `resources/LoD/`, for `Sardinia` and for `SHCS`: `<cohort>_trajectories_threshold_ages.txt`,
`<cohort>_predicted_trajectories_derivatives2_zero_extrap.txt` and `<cohort>_predicted_trajectories_derivatives2_LoD2_extrap.txt`. The files of
both cohorts come from one run of the same `spec_main` (section 2).


# 1. Data

```{r}
sard_calls <- read.table(file.path(resources_lod, "sardinia_chip_calls_long_filtered.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>% as_tibble()
shcs_calls <- read.table(shcs_calls_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>% as_tibble()

lod_sard <- sard_calls %>% distinct(traj_id, lod = traj_lod_mean)
lod_shcs <- shcs_calls %>% distinct(traj_id, lod = traj_lod_mean)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(lod_sard$traj_id), !anyNA(lod_sard$lod), !anyDuplicated(lod_shcs$traj_id), !anyNA(lod_shcs$lod))

bind_rows(lod_shcs %>% mutate(Cohort = "SHCS"), lod_sard %>% mutate(Cohort = "Sardinia")) %>%
  group_by(Cohort) %>%
  summarise(trajectories = n(),
            `mean LoD of the trajectories, median (range) %` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)", 100 * median(lod), 100 * min(lod), 100 * max(lod))) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```


# 2. Ages

```{r}
extrap_cols <- c("Age", "ID", "traj_id", "VAF", "VAF_speed", "VAF_acceleration", "N_CHIP", "Gene.refGene", "data_point", "out_of_range",
                 "Time", "VAF_acceleration_sign")

predicted_trajectories2 <- predict_all(sard_calls, spec_main, extrapolate = TRUE) %>% select(all_of(extrap_cols))
stopifnot(setequal(predicted_trajectories2$traj_id, sard_calls$traj_id))

age_zero <- threshold_ages(predicted_trajectories2, lod_sard)
stopifnot(nrow(age_zero) == n_distinct(sard_calls$traj_id),
          with(age_zero, all(Age_zero <= Age_LoD2, Age_LoD2 <= Age_LoD, Age_LoD <= Age_0.02, na.rm = TRUE)))

shcs_pred2 <- predict_all(shcs_calls, spec_main, extrapolate = TRUE) %>% select(all_of(extrap_cols))
shcs_ages  <- threshold_ages(shcs_pred2, lod_shcs)
stopifnot(setequal(shcs_pred2$traj_id, shcs_calls$traj_id),
          with(shcs_ages, all(Age_zero <= Age_LoD2, Age_LoD2 <= Age_LoD, Age_LoD <= Age_0.02, na.rm = TRUE)))
```

The two cohorts use the same `spec_main`. The next chunk is a comparison of the SHCS ages with an earlier version of the
analysis (`resources/SHCS_trajectories_threshold_ages.txt`, not part of this repository); it runs only if that file is present:

```{r, eval = file.exists("resources/SHCS_trajectories_threshold_ages.txt")}
# optional: against the ages of an earlier version of the analysis
saved_ages <- read.table("resources/SHCS_trajectories_threshold_ages.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)

shcs_ages %>%
  pivot_longer(-traj_id, names_to = "age", values_to = "here") %>%
  left_join(saved_ages %>% pivot_longer(-traj_id, names_to = "age", values_to = "file"), by = c("traj_id", "age")) %>%
  mutate(age = factor(age, levels = c("Age_zero", "Age_LoD2", "Age_LoD", "Age_0.02"))) %>%
  group_by(age) %>%
  summarise(`both estimated` = sum(!is.na(here) & !is.na(file)), `only in this notebook` = sum(!is.na(here) & is.na(file)),
            `only in the file` = sum(is.na(here) & !is.na(file)),
            `difference (years), median (IQR)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", median(here - file, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                         quantile(here - file, .25, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(here - file, .75, na.rm = TRUE)),
            `Spearman rho` = cor(here, file, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

```{r}
ages_long <- bind_rows(shcs_ages %>% mutate(Cohort = "SHCS"), age_zero %>% mutate(Cohort = "Sardinia")) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Age_zero, Age_LoD2, Age_LoD, Age_0.02), names_to = "age", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(age = factor(age, levels = c("Age_zero", "Age_LoD2", "Age_LoD", "Age_0.02")))

ages_long %>%
  group_by(age, Cohort) %>%
  summarise(estimated = sum(!is.na(value)), `left-censored (NA)` = sum(is.na(value)),
            `median (IQR)` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f-%.1f)", median(value, na.rm = T), quantile(value, .25, na.rm = T),
                                     quantile(value, .75, na.rm = T)),
            range = sprintf("%.1f-%.1f", min(value, na.rm = T), max(value, na.rm = T)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Ages at the VAF thresholds")
```

Time between the ages (years), for the trajectories that have both:

```{r}
bind_rows(shcs_ages %>% mutate(Cohort = "SHCS"), age_zero %>% mutate(Cohort = "Sardinia")) %>%
  transmute(Cohort, `origin -> LoD/2` = Age_LoD2 - Age_zero, `LoD/2 -> LoD` = Age_LoD - Age_LoD2, `LoD -> 2%` = Age_0.02 - Age_LoD,
            `LoD/2 -> 2%` = Age_0.02 - Age_LoD2, `origin -> 2%` = Age_0.02 - Age_zero) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Cohort, names_to = "interval", values_to = "years") %>%
  mutate(interval = fct_inorder(interval)) %>%
  group_by(interval, Cohort) %>%
  summarise(trajectories = sum(!is.na(years)),
            `median (IQR)` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f-%.1f)", median(years, na.rm = T), quantile(years, .25, na.rm = T),
                                     quantile(years, .75, na.rm = T)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

## 2.1 Ages by gene

```{r, fig.width=13, fig.height=4.5}
ages_gene <- age_zero %>%
  left_join(predicted_trajectories2 %>% distinct(traj_id, Gene.refGene), by = "traj_id") %>%
  mutate(Gene.refGene = as.character(group_genes(Gene.refGene)))

age_by_gene <- function(df, age, ylab) {
  bind_rows(df, df %>% mutate(Gene.refGene = "All genes")) %>%
    mutate(Gene.refGene = factor(Gene.refGene, levels = c("All genes", gene_levels))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = .data[[age]], x = Gene.refGene)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Gene.refGene)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = gene_colors) +
    theme_classic() + xlab("") + ylab(ylab) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "None")
}

gridExtra::grid.arrange(age_by_gene(ages_gene, "Age_zero", "Age at 0.1%"), age_by_gene(ages_gene, "Age_LoD2", "Age at LoD/2"),
                        age_by_gene(ages_gene, "Age_LoD", "Age at LoD"), age_by_gene(ages_gene, "Age_0.02", "Age at VAF 2%"), nrow = 1)
```


# 3. Curves extrapolated to LoD / 2

`predict_trajectory()` of `spline_functions.R`, with the LoD / 2 of the trajectory in place of `zero_vaf`:

```{r}
predict_extrap_lod2 <- function(obs, lod, spec = spec_main) {
  obs <- arrange(obs, Age)
  f <- fit_traj(obs$Age, obs$AF, spec)
  lod2 <- lod / 2
  ages <- seq(min(obs$Age), max(obs$Age), by = step)
  if (max(f$predict(min(ages)), 0) > lod2) {
    ages0 <- seq(0, max(obs$Age), by = step)
    below <- which(f$predict(ages0) < lod2)
    below <- below[below < which(ages0 == min(obs$Age))]
    if (length(below) > 0) ages <- ages0[max(below):length(ages0)]
  }
  spline_curves(f$predict, ages) %>%
    mutate(ID = obs$ID[1], traj_id = obs$traj_id[1], N_CHIP = obs$N_CHIP[1], Gene.refGene = obs$Gene.refGene[1],
           data_point = as.numeric(Age %in% obs$Age), out_of_range = as.numeric(!(Age %in% obs$Age)),
           traj_lod = lod, VAF_spline = VAF, VAF = pmax(VAF_spline, lod2)) %>%
    arrange(Age) %>%
    mutate(Time = 0:(n() - 1), VAF_acceleration_sign = sign(VAF_acceleration))
}

predict_all_lod2 <- function(calls, lod_tbl) {
  calls %>%
    group_split(traj_id) %>%
    map(~ predict_extrap_lod2(.x, lod_tbl$lod[match(.x$traj_id[1], lod_tbl$traj_id)])) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    select(all_of(c(extrap_cols, "VAF_spline", "traj_lod")))
}

sard_lod2 <- predict_all_lod2(sard_calls, lod_sard)
shcs_lod2 <- predict_all_lod2(shcs_calls, lod_shcs)
stopifnot(setequal(sard_lod2$traj_id, sard_calls$traj_id), setequal(shcs_lod2$traj_id, shcs_calls$traj_id))
```

How far the curves are extended, against the first measurement:

```{r}
extension <- function(pred, calls) {
  pred %>%
    group_by(traj_id) %>%
    summarise(start = min(Age), traj_lod = first(traj_lod), start_VAF = VAF_spline[which.min(Age)], .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(calls %>% group_by(traj_id) %>% summarise(first_age = min(Age), .groups = "drop"), by = "traj_id") %>%
    mutate(years_before = first_age - start, reaches = start_VAF < traj_lod / 2 | start < first_age)
}

ext_all <- bind_rows(extension(shcs_lod2, shcs_calls) %>% mutate(Cohort = "SHCS"),
                     extension(sard_lod2, sard_calls) %>% mutate(Cohort = "Sardinia"))

ext_all %>%
  group_by(Cohort) %>%
  summarise(trajectories = n(), `extended` = sum(years_before > 0),
            `not extended: at or below LoD / 2 at the first measurement` = sum(years_before == 0 & start_VAF <= traj_lod / 2),
            `not extended: never below LoD / 2 before the first measurement` = sum(years_before == 0 & start_VAF > traj_lod / 2),
            `years before the first measurement, median (IQR) of the extended` =
              sprintf("%.1f (%.1f-%.1f)", median(years_before[years_before > 0]), quantile(years_before[years_before > 0], .25),
                      quantile(years_before[years_before > 0], .75)),
            `extended beyond 30 years` = sum(years_before > 30)) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
bind_rows(shcs_lod2 %>% mutate(ID = as.character(ID), Cohort = "SHCS"), sard_lod2 %>% mutate(Cohort = "Sardinia")) %>%
  mutate(Gene.refGene = group_genes(Gene.refGene)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = VAF, group = traj_id, color = Cohort)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = chip_vaf, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = hiv_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~Gene.refGene) +
  ggtitle("Curves extrapolated to LoD / 2") +
  theme_classic()
```
